Kratki odgovori na pitanja prije implant: Short answers to questions before implant treatment.
Koliko je bolna ugradnja zubnog implanta: How painful is dental implant placement?
Zahvat se najčešće izvodi u lokalnoj ane: The procedure is usually carried out under local anaesthesia, so you should not feel pain during placement. Swelling and discomfort are possible afterwards and usually subside within a few days.
All-on-4 je koncept fiksne nadoknade zub: All-on-4 is a concept of fixed replacement of all teeth in one jaw on four implants. All-on-X covers similar solutions, with the number of implants adapted to individual findings.
Koja je razlika između All-on-4 i All-on: What is the difference between All-on-4 and All-on-6?
All-on-4 oslanja se na četiri, a All-on-: All-on-4 relies on four implants and All-on-6 on six. The choice depends on bone condition, bite and other clinical factors.
Koliko brzo mogu dobiti fiksne zube?: How soon can I get fixed teeth?
U određenim slučajevima privremeni fiksn: In certain cases a temporary fixed restoration can be made within a relatively short period after implant placement, but same-day fabrication should not be assumed.
